papers.title_en: Compressing Onboard Language Models for Space Robots under a Behavioral-Fidelity Requirement
papers.authors: Jia Deng, Zizhe Wang, Xin Lu, Yi Huang, Zehao Jia
papers.evidence: 将 AWQ 与 GPTQ 等低比特检查点组合为单一静态训练后量化模型
papers.tldr: 空间机器人机载语言模型需低比特压缩，但通用训练后量化未显式保证固定存储、静态产物与地面验证的行为保真。作者将压缩置于地面段，提出QSelect，按线性模块组合AWQ、GPTQ与AutoRound检查点，并以最终下一词分布评分替换。在多个7B/8B/3B模型3/4比特设置下，组合模型留出困惑度均低于单一家族，保真模式进一步降低KL。贡献是为航天部署提供可配置、无需标签的静态压缩流程。
papers.abstract_en: Language models are being explored as the interface through which space robots interpret operator commands and select among verified skills. Running them onboard calls for low-bit compression, and flight use adds requirements that generic post-training quantization leaves implicit: a fixed memory budget and storage format, a static artifact under configuration control, and behavior close to the full-precision model validated on the ground. We treat compression as a ground-segment step and study QSelect, which composes one static low-bit model from compatible AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound checkpoints by assigning each linear module to one quantizer family and scoring every substitution at the final next-token distribution. The default fidelity mode needs no labels or tuned thresholds and accepts a substitution only when the forward KL divergence from the BF16 reference decreases; an optional target-adapted mode adds answer likelihood on a small labeled set. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Llama-3.2-3B at 3 and 4 bits, composed models reach lower mean held-out perplexity than every single-family model in all six settings, and the fidelity mode lowers perplexity and KL further. In a matched scaffold, final-output scoring gives lower held-out KL than representation-similarity scoring in all 12 paired runs. With labels from training or development splits of the evaluated task families, the target-adapted mode raises 3-bit pooled accuracy on the two Llama models by 4.3 and 4.5 points over the best single-family model. At 3 bits, unquantized embedding and output layers make up 43-46% of the packed artifact. All evaluations use general-domain benchmarks on a ground GPU; space-domain tasks and flight hardware are left to future work.

papers.title_en: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
papers.authors: Patrick Haller, Filipe Laitenberger, Alan Akbik
papers.evidence: 语言模型循环状态的事后四比特量化
papers.tldr: 线性注意力模型需为每条解码序列保存固定大小的循环状态，低精度存储可提升并发。PACE 是事后四位状态量化器：每隔若干生成 token 才舍入一次，并将中间 token 暂存于小缓冲，以减少累积误差；同时按列共享量化尺度，并对误差滞留最久的 head 保留八位。在 4B 至 35B 的四个混合模型上，混合四位/八位在三个较大模型上以约三分之二内存媲美八位 DAMP，全四位在同内存下优于 Q-Mamba，并保持解码加速。
papers.abstract_en: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.
